WITH order_type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS executed_order_count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordertune, executed_order_count,
         executed_order_count::numeric / SUM(executed_order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM order_type_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(executed_order_count) AS sum_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
